column7: New York's pick goes to Brooklyn unprotected.
Houston can swap its own pick for Brooklyn's.
Phoenix's pick goes to Houston unprotected.
Atlanta's pick goes to San Antonio unprotected.
Miami's pick goes to Charlotte if it lands 15-30 (else Miami's 2028 first).
Dallas's pick goes to Charlotte if it lands 3-30.
The Lakers' pick goes to Memphis if it lands 5-30.
San Antonio's pick goes to Sacramento if it lands 1-16 and to Oklahoma City if 17-30.
Of Cleveland's, Minnesota's and Utah's picks: the best to Memphis, the next to Utah, the worst to Phoenix; Utah keeps its own if it lands 1-5.
New Orleans takes the better of its own and Milwaukee's picks and Atlanta the other, unless both land 1-4: then New Orleans keeps both.

Oklahoma City takes the two best of its own, the Clippers' and Denver's picks (if Denver's lands 1-5, Denver keeps it and OKC takes the better of the other two); the Clippers take the better of the one left and Toronto's, Toronto the other.
